entities.name: Voltaire Institute and Museum
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Institut et Musée Voltaire is a museum in Geneva dedicated to the life and works of Voltaire. The museum is housed in Les Délices, which was Voltaire's home from 1755 until 1760.
